name: m4l-launchpad-sequencer
description: A step sequencer for the Novation Launchpad, for use with Ableton Live and Max for Live.

scripts.ci: npm run test-strict && npm run build
scripts.sync-examples: cp device/* 'examples/Template Project/Presets/MIDI Effects/Max MIDI Effect/Imported' && cp device/* 'examples/Advanced Example Project/Presets/MIDI Effects/Max MIDI Effect/Imported'
scripts.release: NODE_OPTIONS='--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning' npm run build && npm run sync-examples && zip -r releases/launchpad-sequencer-1.2.zip device examples -x */Backup/*

author: Adam Murray
